ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Registration is restricted to GSE cohort students only. Elluminate usage for synchronous meetings to be held on: June 21st, June 28th, July 5th, July 12th and August 9th. The dates for the course in Chile are: Summer Semester 2: July 16 - July 28, 2012 The Elluminate online conferencing technology will be used to deliver synchronous class sessions. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois, Board of Trustees.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to EDM: Ed Policy St - UIUC.
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $362.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
